node.question: Is the mug visibly positioned to the right of the headphones?
node.criteria: Apply the original rubric to R1 only. Complete (yes) if the mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones. Absent (no) only if there is clear evidence that no requested change has progressed. Partial if there is evidence of some progress toward moving the mug to the right of the headphones but the requested relationship is not complete. Unknown if required evidence is insufficient or unresolved; do not infer completion, absence, or progress from unrelated edits.
